title: Episode 2: Project Radar, Jackbox, and the Group Chat
target_runtime: Full episode: 8-12 minutes; dispatch with test_mode=false
source_attribution_policy: Treat source and author labels as production context for Felix and Jasper, not words to read aloud.

Attribute a statement or action to Joel only when a note explicitly says Joel personally said or did it. A newsletter, developer email, bug tracker, or third-party email is not Joel speaking, even when it concerns him or is in his inbox.

For Jackbox-related external updates, attribute claims to Jackbox or the named Jackbox source; never recast them as Joel's observations, gameplay, or words. If the provided source does not support a detail, leave it out.
Do not narrate research limitations, prompt rules, source notes, or verification policies. Omit unsupported details rather than explaining that the hosts cannot invent or confirm them.
topics: Open casually and check in on Snowy, Bone TD, BattleTabs, and gaming. Bring back the brief BattleTabs/Bone TD balancing callback and Slurpee run without inventing new events.

GDevelop: cover Snowy's interest in Bouh Water Showcase, a 3D pixel-art level generator, and Block Blast/Cookie Clicker-style templates. Separate user project ideas and community experiments from official engine releases. Prior research did not verify a specific recent official GDevelop update; do not present the community forum work as shipped official functionality.

Jackbox: The official Jackbox Games account says The Jackbox Party Pack 12 is coming October 15, 2026, with five games: MegaPals, We Forgot A Card!, Idol Factions, Hyperface, and Debate & Switch. The official account also says Trivia Murder Party 3 is in Early Access on Steam and Epic. Attribute these as official-account announcements; Party Pack 12 has not released as of September 28, 2026.

My Arms Are Longer Now: treat this only as Jackbox-related external news/update, never as Joel's report, observation, statement, or gameplay. The available note mentions the main game disappearing while a giveaway remained, plus V6 and a recent promotion. Attribute those details only to the Jackbox source if the source itself supports them; do not say or imply Joel used V6, saw the disappearance, or personally reported it. If the source does not verify a detail, omit it.

Bone TD and BattleTabs: keep the familiar games and balancing callback, but do not invent recent patches, statistics, match outcomes, or balance changes. No specific current official update was verified in the earlier research.

Course update: Joel reported seven missing uploads and concern that AI grading may be involved; identify this as his report/concern, not a confirmed school explanation. A September 22, 2026 Gmail item is a DRAFT follow-up about the missing Grade 11 Health for Life (PPZ3C) completion/grade on the portal and transcript; it says the final exam was taken June 22, 2026 and references earlier inquiries. Do not claim the draft was sent or that the school replied.

7-Eleven rewards: Joel is tracking Slurpee and pepperoni-pizza rewards/points. As checked September 28, 2026, Poke has unpaused one-time reminders on Tuesday, October 20 and Monday, October 26, 2026 about 7-Eleven refreshers costing 500 points being removed Tuesday, October 27, plus a Thursday, November 19, 2026 points-expiration check/redeem reminder. No live account balance was verified; do not claim a current points balance.
Interac: Joel mentioned a $5.75 transfer from Zac. Keep this as a brief user-reported note; do not infer its purpose, whether it cleared, or any additional financial details.

Offline Radar / Sunday text logs: read exact message text and preserve spelling, punctuation, accents, and sender attribution. Do not read out or narrate timestamps, dates, times, message IDs, or metadata headers from the logs. Include Miko Haldeman's message verbatim; use the supplied context that Miko is praising the automated Sunday podcast idea and suggesting Joel build a public AI service/startup as playful banter for Felix and Jasper. Keep that context separate from Miko's verbatim wording. Preserve Sayer Smith's sticker-reaction wording and quoted text exactly; do not invent which sticker was used or anything about Ari. Include Canon Smith's sticker reaction verbatim. For Sayer Smith's Spanish-log message, use the supplied context that Sayer is confused by the Spanish text “Le gustó una imagen,” which the user says came from iMessage storing the image tapback in Spanish in chat.db, and jokes by asking when they said it. Play up the comic confusion, but preserve the original message exactly and do not claim Sayer deliberately spoke Spanish. Do not infer meanings from other fragments or invent messages.

Latest group-chat banter: Sayer Smith says they accidentally liked an image and explains their keyboard is constantly in Spanish; treat the Spanish tapback “Le gustó una imagen” as an iMessage artifact, not intentional Spanish. Miko Haldeman repeatedly types “collage” when meaning college, Canon corrects him and jokes about autocorrect, and Miko explains the distinction. Miko pitches Joel on moving to Florida for Christian college, offers to drive/help, and proposes a summer trip from Seattle to Alaska by motorcycle or VW Beetle, tent-camping for about a month; Sayer likes the vision but notes they will be 15. Miko also suggests Joel build an AI service for the public. Madden Long and Sayer Smith banter about Discord, notifications, and growing up faster to get it. Present these as conversation prompts, not as confirmed plans or commitments.
